name: Events in Portugal, by place
owner: Câmara Municipal de Lisboa (Agenda Cultural de Lisboa, agendalx.pt) Câmara Municipal de Lagos (cm-lagos.pt), Teatro das Figuras, Faro (teatrodasfiguras.pt) and Câmara Municipal de Tavira (cm-tavira.pt)
gives: Public events on now or in the next 60 days in Lisbon and the Algarve places, as schema.org Event records, each with its source URL and the time read.

terms.summary: Strictest of the sources: no reuse licence or terms page was found for any of the four hosts (teatrodasfiguras.pt and cm-tavira.pt show only "Todos os direitos reservados" in their footers, and cm-tavira.pt has no robots.txt). The robots.txt files that exist allow the paths read; agendalx.pt sets Content-Signal search=yes, ai-train=no, use=reference. So: reference use only, name the source, link to the event, no AI training. Not reviewed by a person: whether this is enough to republish is for Dinis.
